11643-john-caldigate.title: John Caldigate
11643-john-caldigate.creator: Anthony Trollope
11643-john-caldigate.description: A book by Anthony Trollope. s son John Caldigate, that they two could not live together in comfort in the days of the young man's early youth. And yet it would have been much for both of them that such comfortable association should have been possible to them.

arxiv-1403-7920.title: Computing the dimension of ideals in group algebras, with an application to coding theory
arxiv-1403-7920.creator: Michele Elia, Elisa Gorla
arxiv-1403-7920.description: A 2014 arXiv research paper by Michele Elia, Elisa Gorla. The problem of computing the dimension of a left/right ideal in a group algebra 𝔽 ⁡ [ 𝒢 ] {\mathbb{F}}[{\mathcal{G}}] of a finite group 𝒢 {\mathcal{G}} over a field 𝔽 {\mathbb{F}} is considered.

arxiv-1911-02679.title: A Domain-Specific Language for Verifying Software Requirement Constraints Journal: Science of Computer Programming
arxiv-1911-02679.creator: Marzina Vidal, Tiago Massoni, Franklin Ramalho
arxiv-1911-02679.description: Abstract Software requirement analysis can certainly benefit from prevention and early detection of failures, in particular by some kind of automatic analysis. Formal methods offer means to represent and analyze requirements with rigorous tools, avoiding ambiguities and allowing automatic verification of requirement consistency.

arxiv-2110-12818.title: Theory of non-equilibrium “hot” carriers in direct band-gap semiconductors under continuous illumination
arxiv-2110-12818.creator: Subhajit Sarkar, Ieng-Wai Un and Yonatan Sivan, Yonatan Dubi
arxiv-2110-12818.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Subhajit Sarkar, Ieng-Wai Un and Yonatan Sivan, Yonatan Dubi. The interplay between the illuminated excitation of carriers and subsequent thermalization and recombination leads to the formation of non-equilibrium distributions for the “hot” carriers and to heating of both electrons, holes and phonons. In spite of the fundamental and practical importance of these processes, there is no theoretical framework which encompasses all of them and provides a clear prediction for the non-equilibrium carrier distributions.

arxiv-2110-15657.title: Asymptotic Symmetry of Four Dimensional Einstein-Yang-Mills and Einstein-Maxwell Theory
arxiv-2110-15657.creator: Nabamita Banerjee, Tabasum Rahnuma, and Ranveer Kumar Singh
arxiv-2110-15657.description: Abstract Asymptotic symmetry plays an important role in determining physical observables of a theory. Recently, in the context of four dimensional asymptotically flat pure gravity and 𝒩 = 1 \mathcal{N}=1 supergravity, it has been proposed that OPEs of appropriate celestial amplitudes can be used to find their asymptotic symmetries.

arxiv-2112-06783.title: A sea surface-based drag model for Large Eddy Simulation of wind-wave interaction
arxiv-2112-06783.description: Abstract Monin-Obukhov similarity theory (MOST) is a well tested approach for specifying the fluxes when the roughness surfaces are homogeneous. For flow over waves (inhomogeneous surfaces), phase-averaged roughness length scales are often prescribed through models based on the wave characteristics and the wind speed.

arxiv-2202-09005.title: Reviews in motion: a large scale, longitudinal study of review recommendations on Yelp
arxiv-2202-09005.creator: Ryan Amos, Roland Maio, Prateek Mittal
arxiv-2202-09005.description: Abstract . The United Nations Consumer Protection Guidelines lists “access … to adequate information … to make informed choices” as a core consumer protection right. However, problematic online reviews and imperfections in algorithms that detect those reviews pose obstacles to the fulfillment of this right.

arxiv-2211-13918.title: The American Put Option with A Random Time Horizon
arxiv-2211-13918.creator: Zhuoshu Wu, Libo Li
arxiv-2211-13918.description: Abstract This paper is intended to provide a unique valuation formula for the American put option in a random time horizon; more precisely, such option restricts any stopping rules to be made before the last exit time of the price of the underlying assets at any fixed level.

arxiv-2301-00790.title: Online learning techniques for prediction of temporal tabular datasets with regime changes
arxiv-2301-00790.creator: Thomas Wong, Mauricio Barahona
arxiv-2301-00790.description: Abstract The application of deep learning to non-stationary temporal datasets can lead to overfitted models that underperform under regime changes. In this work, we propose a modular machine learning pipeline for ranking predictions on temporal panel datasets which is robust under regime changes.

arxiv-2406-15583.title: Detecting AI-Generated Text: Factors Influencing Detectability with Current Methods
arxiv-2406-15583.creator: Kathleen C. Fraser kathleen.fraser@nrc-cnrc.gc.ca
arxiv-2406-15583.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Kathleen C. Fraser kathleen.fraser@nrc-cnrc.gc.ca. Large language models (LLMs) have advanced to a point that even humans have difficulty discerning whether a text was generated by another human, or by a computer. However, knowing whether a text was produced by human or artificial intelligence (AI) is important to determining its trustworthiness, and has applications in many domains including detecting fraud and academic dishonesty, as well as combating the spread of misinformation and political propaganda.

arxiv-2502-00579.title: Intrinsic Random Functions and Parametric Covariance Models of Spatio-Temporal Random Processes on the Sphere
arxiv-2502-00579.creator: Jongwook Kim, Chunfeng Huang, Nicholas Bussberg
arxiv-2502-00579.description: Abstract Identifying an appropriate covariance function is one of the primary interests in spatial and spatio-temporal statistics because it allows researchers to analyze the dependence structure of the random process. For this purpose, spatial homogeneity and temporal stationarity are widely used assumptions, and many parametric covariance models have been developed under these assumptions.

arxiv-2508-20614.title: Towards Trustworthy Amortized Bayesian Model Comparison
arxiv-2508-20614.creator: Šimon Kucharský, Aayush Mishra, Daniel Habermann, Stefan T. Radev, Paul-Christian Bürkner
arxiv-2508-20614.description: Abstract Amortized Bayesian model comparison (BMC) enables fast probabilistic ranking of models via simulation-based training of neural surrogates. However, the reliability of neural surrogates deteriorates when simulation models are misspecified—the very case where model comparison is most needed. Thus, we supplement simulation-based training with a self-consistency (SC) loss on unlabeled real data to improve BMC estimates under empirical distribution shifts.

arxiv-2604-04295.title: Adaptive Cost-Efficient Evaluation for Reliable Patent Claim Validation
arxiv-2604-04295.creator: Yongmin Yoo, Qiongkai Xu, Longbing Cao, {qiongkai.xu, longbing.cao}@mq.edu.au

patriotic-plays-and-pageants-for-young-p.title: Patriotic Plays and Pageants for Young People
patriotic-plays-and-pageants-for-young-p.creator: Constance D'Arcy Mackay

pmc-10596969.title: The use of employment and social services and rehabilitation after the onset of unemployment
pmc-10596969.creator: H Rinne, R Perhoniemi
pmc-10596969.description: BackgroundEven though employment and social services and rehabilitation are available to the unemployed, there is little information about their service paths after the onset of unemployment. The aim was to follow different service spells using sequence analysis among those who became unemployed.

pmc-10632939.title: Modeling the future of tobacco control: Using SimSmoke to explore the feasibility of the tobacco endgame in Korea
pmc-10632939.creator: Hana Kim, Susan Park, Heewon Kang, Naeun Kang, David T. Levy, Sung-il Cho
pmc-10632939.description: INTRODUCTIONWe used a simulation model to assess the feasibility of reaching the tobacco endgame target (reducing the smoking prevalence to below 5% by 2050) and explored potential implementation strategies.METHODSThe impact of strengthened tobacco-control policies on smoking prevalence was analyzed using Korea SimSmoke, a discrete-time Markov process.

pmc-11484223.title: Inflammation‑based prognostic markers in patients with advanced or recurrent gastric cancer treated with nivolumab: Tokushukai REAl‑world Data project 02 (TREAD 02)
pmc-11484223.creator: Rai Shimoyama, Yoshinori Imamura, Kiyoaki Uryu, Takahiro Mase, Megu Ohtaki, Keiko Ohtani, Megumi Shiragami, Yoshiaki Fujimura, Maki Hayashi, Nobuaki Shinozaki, Hironobu Minami
pmc-11484223.description: In addition to blood test data, inflammation-based prognostic markers have been used to predict the prognosis of various types of cancer. However, several of these previous studies may be outdated, as they were conducted prior to the widespread adoption of immune checkpoint inhibitors, leading to limited reports on their efficacy.

pmc-11513664.title: CVN424, a GPR6 inverse agonist, for Parkinson's disease and motor fluctuations: a double-blind, randomized, phase 2 trial
pmc-11513664.creator: Nicola L. Brice, Mark Carlton, David H. Margolin, Martin Bexon, Kim L. Matthews, Lee A. Dawson, Aaron L. Ellenbogen, C. Warren Olanow, Jordan Dubow, Karl Kieburtz
pmc-11513664.description: SummaryBackgroundCVN424 is a GPR6 inverse agonist that provides selective pharmacological control of the indirect striatopallidal pathway. We assessed the safety and efficacy of CVN424 as an adjunctive treatment to levodopa for reducing OFF-time in individuals with Parkinson's disease (PD) experiencing motor-fluctuations.

pmc-12363019.title: Predictive value of combined inflammatory markers for septic cardiomyopathy: a retrospective study
pmc-12363019.creator: Xianqi Lan, Huiqiang Mai
pmc-12363019.description: BackgroundSeptic cardiomyopathy (SCM) is a common but underdiagnosed complication of sepsis characterized by acute myocardial dysfunction driven by inflammatory and immune dysregulation. This study aimed to investigate the clinical characteristics, inflammatory profiles, and predictive markers associated with SCM, highlighting its diagnostic and prognostic importance.

pmc-12492021.title: Dual enhancement of pork color stability: Antioxidant activity and myoglobin structural compactness mediated by L-histidine/L-arginine
pmc-12492021.creator: Xiuyun Guo, Chao Fu, Shuangyi Xu, Jiangpeng Yao, Kaixian Zhu, Xiangren Meng
pmc-12492021.description: This study aimed to investigate the effect of L-histidine (His) and L-arginine (Arg) on the color of pork and reveal the possible mechanism. The a* value increased by 2.36 %, 4.78 % and 8.65 % with 0.10–0.30 % His, and by 3.45 %, 8.40 % and 13.06 % with 0.10–0.30 % Arg, respectively (P < 0.05).

pmc-12980850.creator: Shuya Kandori, Kosuke Kojo, Akio Hoshi, Reo Takahashi, Hiromichi Sakurai, Bunpei Isoda, Shuhei Suzuki, Akane Yamaguchi, Kozaburo Tanuma, Satoshi Nitta, Masanobu Shiga, Yoshiyuki Nagumo, Atsushi Ikeda, Takashi Kawahara, Bryan J Mathis, Hiroyuki Nishiyama

pmc-13084531.title: Brain health care accelerator: A primary care–centered model for scaling dementia diagnosis and care
pmc-13084531.creator: Jeffrey M Burns, Jill K Morris, Eric D Vidoni, Ryan A Townley, Lindsey R Gillen, Timothy R Smith, Janell E Jones, Melody B Nelson, Dinesh Pal Mudaranthakam, Jaime Perales‐Puchalt, Tina Lewandowski, C Michelle Niedens, Adam C Parks, Amanda M Brunette, Andrew J Aschenbrenner, Taylor I Bucy, Rachel C F
pmc-13084531.description: Plasma biomarkers and disease‐modifying therapies for early Alzheimer's disease have created an urgent need for scalable care models. In this Perspectives, we describe how a health system is adapting dementia care delivery through a primary care provider (PCP)–centered initiative designed to improve diagnostic readiness and care capacity.

pmc-13097197.title: How Visible is the Sex Work in Iran?
pmc-13097197.creator: Azam Rastegari, Mohammad Reza Baneshi, Nooshin Zarei, Hassan Joulaei, Mohammad Reza Heydari
pmc-13097197.description: BackgroundNetwork Scale-Up (NSU) is a promising tool in the size estimation of stigmatized behaviors. In NSU, participants from the general population describe the frequency of stigmatized behaviors in their network. To avoid underestimation, due to the invisibility of sensitive behaviors, NSU results should be adjusted by the Visibility Factor (VF).

pmc-13194425.title: Fungal fuel cells: an environmentally friendly approach to addressing heavy metal pollution and electricity production
pmc-13194425.creator: Muhammad Tanveer Altaf, Aisha Umar, Mustansar Mubeen, Amjad Ali, Talha Shafique, Muhammad Asif Shabbir, Yasir Iftikhar, Muhammad Ahmad Zeshan, Manoj Kumar Solanki, Ahmed Mahmoud Ismail, Hossam S. El-Beltagi
pmc-13194425.description: Heavy metal contamination of soil and water is an escalating global environmental issue driven by industrialization and poor waste management. This problem is no longer confined to urban areas, as even small towns are grappling with severe heavy metal contamination, posing substantial threats to human health and aquatic ecosystems.

pmc-13224265.title: Sporadic solid hemangioblastoma of the cerebellar vermis: A case report
pmc-13224265.creator: Abiodun Idowu Okunlola, Kasiemobi Eberechukwu Uchime, Olaniyi Abiodun Olatunde, Shina Abidemi Olalere, Kolawole Alexander Ige, Cecilia Kehinde Okunlola
pmc-13224265.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background: Hemangioblastomas are rare, benign tumors of the central nervous system, most commonly affecting the cerebellum, brainstem, and spinal cord. They are often associated with von Hippel-Lindau disease but can also occur sporadically.Case Description: This case report presents a 60-year-old male with a sporadic solid hemangioblastoma of the cerebellar vermis, detailing his clinical presentation, radiological findings, surgical management, and postoperative outcome.Conclusion: Although rare, these tumors should be considered in the differential diagnosis of posterior fossa masses in adults.

pmc-13258428.title: Language-Specific Differences in Large Language Model Diagnostic Reasoning: A Translation-Controlled Clinical Vignette Study
pmc-13258428.creator: Jakub Magdziarz Ibrahim-El-Nur, Wojciech Kaczmarek, Weronika Winiarska, Adrian Kuś, Magdalena Łoś
pmc-13258428.description: Background: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being evaluated for clinically relevant diagnostic tasks, yet their performance may vary across languages. We aimed to determine whether input language influences LLM diagnostic reasoning in vignette-based clinical tasks and to inform multilingual predeployment evaluation for non-English healthcare systems.

pmc-13387706.title: Knowledge and awareness of female genital cosmetic surgery among healthcare providers: A cross-sectional study
pmc-13387706.creator: Fahad M. Algreisi, Hattan A. Bajahmom, Nada S. AlHarbi, Leena S. Abdulbadie, Ruzanah A. Almarzugi
pmc-13387706.description: Background:Female genital cosmetic surgery (FGCS) became popular in recent decades. Many patients worldwide consider these procedures for medical or esthetic reasons. Previous literature indicates a significant gap in public understanding of the risks, benefits, and recovery processes associated with FGCS. This study aims to assess the knowledge and attitudes of healthcare providers in Makkah clusters regarding FGCS.

pmc-13450710.title: Silent regulators of trauma: the microRNA blueprint underlying post-traumatic stress disorder biology
pmc-13450710.creator: Yogesh Dwivedi, Kevin Prall, Richard C Shelton

pmc-13527243.title: Feasibility and SNR Performance of Hyperpolarized 129Xe Gas Exchange Imaging Using a Balanced SSFP Sequence
pmc-13527243.creator: Agilo L Kern, Marcel Gutberlet, Jens M Hohlfeld, Frank Wacker, Jens Vogel‐Claussen
pmc-13527243.description: PurposeTo develop a balanced SSFP (bSSFP) sequence for pulmonary 129Xe dissolved‐phase imaging based on a previously described double‐echo sequence facilitating separation into red blood cell and membrane signals, to test its feasibility and compare its SNR performance and imaging results to an analogous FLASH sequence.

pmc-13607051.title: Study of Estrogen Receptor-Mediated PGx-eQTLs Identifies Genetic Determinants of Breast Cancer Endocrine Therapy Response
pmc-13607051.creator: Martin Meng, Arnab Ghosh, Huanyao Gao, John August, Shreya Indulkar, Meijie Wang, Xue Wang, Zhuyao Wang, Asadoor Amirkhani Namagerdi, Richard M. Weinshilboum, James N. Ingle, Liewei Wang
pmc-13607051.description: Endocrine therapy remains the cornerstone of treatment for estrogen receptor alpha (ERα)-positive breast cancer, yet the relationship between individual genetic background and molecular response to ERα-targeted therapy remains incompletely understood. Using a well-characterized panel of lymphoblastoid cell lines (LCLs), we performed genome-wide pharmacogenomic expression quantitative trait locus (PGx-eQTL) analysis to identify estradiol (E2)- and tamoxifen (TAM)-induced SNP-gene pairs.

pmc-13669688.title: Topical administration of testosterone ameliorates atopic dermatitis of KFRS4 rats
pmc-13669688.creator: Kenta Hayashi, Kana Nagasaka, Haruki Kitazume, Mao Urasaki, Hoang Trung Hieu, Shinichiro Nakamura, Takashi Kuramoto
pmc-13669688.description: Atopic dermatitis (AD) is a chronic inflammatory skin disorder influenced by genetic, environmental, and immunological factors, and its prevalence shows notable sex-associated differences. KFRS4 rats spontaneously develop AD-like dermatitis with higher severity in females, suggesting a role for sex hormones in disease modulation.
